verdict.rationale: Square lets a multi-tenant app connect to each seller's own account via OAuth (square-docs-42, square-docs-51) and offers 'Collect Application Fees' (square-docs-37), so a platform can take a cut of payments processed on a seller's behalf. A Payouts API is listed (square-docs-17), but the evidence is only a title and does not show the platform directing payouts to sellers. Split payments are limited to an application fee rather than flexible multi-party splits, and onboarding means connecting sellers' existing Square accounts rather than a platform-managed flow. Missing for 10: platform-driven seller onboarding/KYC, arbitrary multi-party payment splitting, documented platform-initiated payouts to each seller, independent or hands-on corroboration.
